newsitem.title: USA: Fuller Brush to market through catalog.
newsitem.headline: Fuller Brush to market through catalog.

text.p: Fuller Brush Co, a subsidiary of CPAC Inc, said Wednesday it has signed a three-year agreement to include its products in a catalog issued by Gempler's, a Wisconsin-based company specializing in hard-to-find products for agriculture, horticulture, and grounds maintenance.
First mailed in 1985, Gempler's catalog is now distributed to more than 2.5 million locations nationwide.
Gempler's offers agricultural, safety, and maintenance products in addition to tires for industrial applications.
Through its subsidiary, Fuller Brush, CPAC makes and markets cleaning and personal care products for household and commercial use.
